title: Automorphisms of Twisted Chevalley Groups of type ${}^2 A_\ell \ (\ell \geq 5)$ over Local Rings
summary: This paper is the first in a series devoted to the classification of automorphisms and isomorphisms of twisted Chevalley groups over commutative rings. In the present paper, we prove that every automorphism of a twisted Chevalley group of type ${}^2A_\ell$ $(\ell \geq 5)$ over a local ring in which $2$ is invertible is standard.
